results.statement: For a physical 3x2 rank-two packet, arbitrary geometric kernel n and Pn nonzero, ||p_Q||inf <= [5*6^(3/5)/2^(13/10)] Delta^(-2/5)||Pn||^(-1/5), continuously.

For a physical triple L and arbitrary-width disjoint original-coordinate bank J with rank A[L,J]=2, Delta the two-singular-value product and n the left kernel, if Pn nonzero then ||p_Q||inf <= [5*6^(3/5)/2^(9/10)] Delta^(-2/5)||Pn||^(-1/5), continuously, with the same linear interval coefficient.
For rank-two C=A[L,J], sum_{r<s}||P(c_r x c_s)||^2=Delta^2||Pn||^2.
